primary_question: Effect of fixed mutation probability, crossover probability and population size on evaluating a strict feasible improvement from a certified nonglobal Hamming-radius-2 local maximum.

novelty.prospective_contribution: Two-start comparison with independently certified local centers and exact global witnesses; distinction between local escape frequency and final optimality gap.

source.name: KPLIB
source.capacity_source: second scalar in each source file, not the range directory name
source.inferential_unit: source-index family, not individual class instance or algorithm repetition
source.family_grouping_basis: conservative blocking by matched source index; full-array and generator dependency audit pending
source.bit_order: item row order in the pinned source file
validation: positive integer profits, weights and capacity
full source paths, byte lengths and SHA-256 frozen before implementation
source order preserved in every mask
missing or invalid source files retained as failures, never substituted

comparison: among infeasible, smaller positive capacity violation wins
objective.algorithm_tie_resolution: uniform random choice using isolated tie stream
objective.duplicate_tournament_participant_tie: uniform among the two drawn positions even when both contain the same population index
objective.report_best_mask_tie_resolution: earliest evaluated feasible mask at the maximum observed profit

algorithm.name: generational binary GA with explicitly specified operators
algorithm.elite_selection: uniform among current population optima under objective comparison
algorithm.selection: two independent size-2 tournaments with replacement for each child

crossover.bit_choice: independent Bernoulli(0.5), choose first or second parent

mutation.type: independent bit flips with probability pm

algorithm.replacement: one carried elite plus all N-1 evaluated children

rng.selection_draw_order: first tournament then second tournament for every child
rng.crossover_draw_order: application draw; 100 independent bit choices only if applied
rng.tie_draws: only when k>1 candidate positions share the best comparison value; two tournament positions are counted separately even for an identical population index

numpy_api.initial_bit_direction: True is bit 1; False is bit 0; the leading zero mask consumes no RNG draws
numpy_api.tournament_participants: rng_selection.integers(0, N, size=2) for each parent; first parent before second
numpy_api.tie_selection: rng_tie.integers(0, k) over ordered tied positions
numpy_api.tournament_tie_same_participant: draw with k=2 even when both tournament positions contain the same population index
numpy_api.crossover_application: rng_crossover.random() < p_c once per child, including p_c=0
numpy_api.crossover_bit_direction: True takes the first parent bit; False takes the second parent bit
numpy_api.crossover_bits_when_not_applied: no bit-choice draws; clone the first parent
numpy_api.mutation_bit_direction: True flips the existing bit; False leaves it unchanged

state_retention.serialization: canonical JSON, UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no BOM, no trailing newline
state_retention.integer_preservation: PCG64 integer state fields remain exact integers; no conversion to floating-point values
state_retention.digest: SHA-256 of the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes

random.population: first N bank masks in original order

greedy_seed.inclusion: include if the new weight is feasible

ascent.neighborhood: all feasible Hamming-distance-1 and Hamming-distance-2 masks
ascent.transition: best strictly higher profit feasible neighbor
ascent.equal_best_neighbor_tie_break: lexicographically smallest tuple of flipped original indices; prefix-shorter tuple first

certificate.certified_condition: no feasible radius-1 or radius-2 neighbor has profit greater than center
certificate.strict_local_maximum: all feasible neighbors have strictly lower profit
certificate.plateau_local_maximum: at least one feasible neighbor has equal profit, none has higher profit

local.admission: complete independent local certificate and center profit strictly below exact global optimum
local.population: N identical clones of the certified center

endpoints.primary: frequency of first evaluated strict feasible profit improvement over the initial local center
endpoints.escape_call_scale: total logical request index including N initialization entries
endpoints.zero_global_profit_gap: null with explicit reason; never divide by zero

best_archive.update: after each evaluated request, only for strictly higher feasible profit
best_archive.stored_mask: immutable value copy, not an alias of an operator-mutated mask

additional_descriptive: local escape times with nonevents retained

statistics.configuration_summary: mean escape indicator over all 30 repetitions
statistics.instance_summary: specified factorial contrast of configuration summaries
statistics.family_summary: mean instance contrast over admitted source classes within sNNN
statistics.study_summary: equal-weight mean of nonempty admitted family summaries
statistics.bootstrap_unit: whole source-index family with all admitted classes, all 27 configurations and all 30 repetitions
statistics.bias_correction_ties: half weight for bootstrap estimates equal to original estimate
statistics.positive_effect_claim: lower BCa confidence bound strictly greater than zero
descriptive_only_conditions: degenerate bootstrap distribution for an affected contrast
nonfinite or reversed interval for an affected contrast

future_ci.job_scope: all 27 configurations for random start; local start only if admitted by frozen registry
future_ci.infrastructure_retry: same task, configuration, start, seed and configuration identity; attempt recorded

acceptance_checks: source format, item ordering, license attribution and file SHA-256
exact feasible/infeasible comparison and uniform ties
tournaments with replacement and independent parent selection
uniform one-child crossover and independent post-crossover bit mutation
single elite and possible persistence of inferior nonelite children
shared bank prefixes and physical-versus-logical initialization accounting
RNG isolation and deterministic replay of an unchanged run identity
exact 5000 logical requests including duplicate and invalid requests
partial terminal generation affects records but not population replacement
deterministic ascent, cap exclusion and complete independent radius-2 certificate
independent exact global witness and no diagnostic leakage to search
strict maxima, plateaus and global centers distinguished; exclusions retained
first evaluated improvement need not be accepted; event at 5000 distinct from censoring
four prespecified contrasts, family clustering and multiplicity correction
incomplete, duplicate, corrupt or SHA-mixed evidence rejected before inferential aggregation
limits: fixed parameters only; no adaptive lambda algorithm
local certification covers Hamming distances 1 and 2 only
all local populations start as identical center clones
population comparisons include different initial request costs and numbers of generations
selected source-index families are not an independent random sample of all knapsack problems
escape superiority does not imply final-gap, time-efficiency or adaptive-algorithm superiority
historical failed reproduction outcomes remain unchanged
